svg.title: Guztchian — software engineering, AI, vision, and robotics
svg.desc: A warm editorial profile with a short introduction, four selected projects, categorized tools, and a closing note.

g.text: Building useful systems around AI, vision, robotics,
and the quiet work of understanding how things fit together.
Hi, I’m Guztchian, a Software Engineering student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
I build practical systems around AI, agents, computer vision, and robotics.
I’m also interested in mathematics, physics, literature, and space — and I write
about projects and technical ideas at dogogod.github.io.
